name: Mii
source:
Itsuki's friend and neighbor. She likes Itsuki but wishes he were a girl. When she meets Futaba, Futaba gives her magic soap so her dream of playing with Itsuki as a young girl can come true.

She attends the same school as Aoi, Tomo, and Yuuki.
